with the bearing S46°55'E, all in all comprising a total area of 59,636.69

The Loay Port Zone, as expanded, is hereby placed under the
administrative jurisdiction of the Philippine Ports Authority, which shall, consistent with
the regional industrial plans of the Government, implemeIit a program for the proper
zoning, planning, development and utilization of the port pursuant to Presidential Decree
No. 857, as amended.

All other orders, proclamations and issuances or portions thereof which
are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
